name: NotYetGames/DlgSystem
description: A free, source-available dialogue plugin for Unreal Engine 5 with graph-based editing, Blueprint and C++ support, event/condition systems, and plain-text import/export. Used in commercial titles like The Ascent.
score_rationale: Well-established Unreal Engine dialogue plugin with 597 stars, actively maintained for UE 5.x, proven in commercial game development.
summary: Production-proven dialogue plugin for Unreal Engine with graph editing
